about: Kunal's report of 11 Nov 2026: on Review he kept hitting the star (next key moment) when he meant the next move. Fixed at #550 (his order: the button row, then the explanation, then the strip; since a21 the streamlined toolbar with Analyze between Key move and Next). Graded by gate 91 (TC-R176a..c) on the Opera Game at ply 10 at 375x761 with his insets and 320x568: the order, Key move and Next at least 40pt apart (104 measured at #553) with both 44pt targets, and a real tap at Next's centre lands on Next and moves exactly one ply. NOT COVERED: his phone check (his).
